FIELDS.NAME: Elegant Living Furniture
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Living Furniture specializes in retailing high-quality furniture and home décor, providing a wide selection of stylish items for residential and commercial spaces. Our operations involve selling pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture, which minimizes installation hazards. We offer dedicated delivery and installation services performed by our trained employees, ensuring quality and safety throughout the process. All our products are stored in secured and monitored facilities to prevent theft and sustain inventory integrity. We prioritize customer satisfaction by adhering to our written return and warranty policy, as well as maintaining an ADA-compliant showroom for accessibility. We do not engage in furniture rental or leasing services, ensuring a focused business approach that minimizes risks associated with such operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 07/15/2023; Cause: Water damage from a burst pipe affecting 150 square feet of inventory; Amount: $3,500; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, UL Listed, Grade 1
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security system with perimeters fencing and regular patrols.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Elegant Living Furniture does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The business primarily focuses on retailing pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture, which minimizes such risks.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Elegant Living Furniture sponsors local athletic teams to promote community engagement and support youth activities. This initiative aligns with our commitment to giving back to the community.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our management team to ensure compliance and protect against liability exposure.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Elegant Living Furniture has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. The business maintains a clean record and focuses on ethical operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Elegant Living Furniture has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance matters have been managed appropriately without issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Elegant Living Furniture does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are directly employed by the company. This structure allows for better control over training and safety protocols.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Elegant Living Furniture carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance and provide coverage for employees in case of work-related injuries. This policy is active and meets legal requirements for our operations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Elegant Living Furniture also owns and operates Elegant Home Decor LLC, which focuses on home décor products, complementing the furniture retail business without creating significant risk.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Elegant Living Furniture currently does not have any other active insurance policies with this company. The only insurance identified is specifically for the business operations outlined.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Elegant Living Furniture is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations strictly focus on retailing pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Elegant Living Furniture does not rent or loan equipment to others, ensuring a focused business approach that minimizes associated risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Elegant Living Furniture has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial standing and adheres to sound financial practices.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Elegant Living Furniture does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus on retailing pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture without engaging in hazardous activities.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Elegant Living Furniture does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused on retailing furniture with robust security measures in place to protect our inventory and facilities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Elegant Living Furniture has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and employee training.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Elegant Living Furniture has no uncorrected fire code violations and prioritizes compliance with all fire safety regulations to ensure a safe environment for both customers and employees.
